tips_en: Read Paper 2 (HumanCLAW) first—it provides a striking diagnostic of why current VLMs fail at embodied tasks, pinpointing 'embodied self-awareness' as the real bottleneck rather than perception. This framing naturally motivates Paper 1 (TurboVLA), which sidesteps LLM-centric VLA limitations with a lean V+L→A architecture, showing that decoupling language reasoning from action execution can still match or beat larger models. Paper 3 (CodeNib) is thematically adjacent in spirit—efficient, structured context serving—but independent in domain, best read as a complement if you're broadly interested in agent infrastructure.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读第二篇（HumanCLAW），它清晰地诊断了当前 VLM 在具身任务中失败的根本原因——不是感知，而是"具身自我意识"的缺失。这一洞见自然引出第一篇（TurboVLA）：通过精简的 V+L→A 架构绕开 LLM 中心化 VLA 的瓶颈，在参数大幅减少的同时仍可媲美或超越更大模型。第三篇（CodeNib）在主题上较为独立，关注的是面向编码代理的高效上下文服务，但如果你对智能体基础设施的整体设计感兴趣，可作为补充阅读。
